title: Polish-Style Green Bean Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with tender green beans and a tangy twist. Perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic; cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add sausage (if using); cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add stew, green beans, caraway seeds, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil; reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, until beans are tender, about 20-25 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley (if desired)
